entities.summary: Boris Ignatyvich Gudz was a Russian centenarian and veteran of the October Revolution and the Russian Civil War as well as an OGPU security agent. At the time of his death, he was one of the last surviving veterans of the Russian Civil War and the last surviving member of Cheka, the secret police of the Soviet Union from 1917 to 1922.
